snippet.title: Ascendora - Demo Trailer | Steam Scream Fest 2026
snippet.description:
The free demo of Ascendora is part of Steam Scream Fest, 26 October - 2 November 2026.

Start on the forest road on a stormy night: pick up the backpack, light the lantern and find a way past the old guard post and the locked gates. Inside, explore the dark lobby, offices and halls of the lab, keep your batteries alive, and use the night vision on your wrist to see what the lantern can't. Work your way to the generator, and bring the power back.

Ascendora is made by Beepy Games, an indie studio from Bedum, the Netherlands.

#Ascendora #HorrorGame #SteamScream
